author: reek
body: GPU-accelerated planet globe. Icosphere (subdivided icosahedron) with runtime texture switching. Supports Earth (file texture or procedural), Mars (procedural), and random planets (procedural). Press E=Earth, M=Mars, R=Random to switch at runtime. No pole seams -- uniform triangles everywhere.

author: reek
body: An IcoTri holds integer world coordinates, like every other stage of the subdivision, and Vec3 is Real. Vec3 is only a carrier for the twelve base vertices, so this is the one place the two meet.

author: reek
body: A Vertex holds integer world coordinates and Mat4 is Real, so the projection converts in on the way to clip space and back out to the integer pixel grid the command buffer wants. At v4w = 1.0 the w is a true homogeneous coordinate, where the old fixed-point code carried thousandths.
